cohort: 2541 patients with previous laparotomies who underwent laparoscopic surgery between January 1992 and October 2015 at two hospitals in Kochi, India.
finding: Visual entry technique using a blunt EndoTIP cannula for laparoscopic surgery in patients with prior laparotomies was associated with fewer bowel injuries compared to the closed, blind entry technique using a sharp linear trocar (3 injuries in the closed group, 0 in the visual entry group; p=0.04).
